description: We’re Zero Gravity, Zero Sleep, Information Systems students from Sunway University tackling Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots. We’re building a web app that turns 20+ years of NASA fire data into a burning calendar, inspired by the haze every Malaysian knows too well. We bring data analysis, dashboards and design. Looking for a web dev (React/Streamlit), someone handy with Python or stats, and anyone into Earth science. Curious and keen to learn? Message us!
